items.title: Trump holds Wasilla, AK rally for Sen. Dan Sullivan; endorses Bernadette Wilson for governor
items.summary: President Trump staged a 90-minute rally Tuesday at the Menard Memorial Sports Center in Wasilla for Sen. Dan Sullivan in the toss-up Senate race (Alaska Survey Research has challenger Mary Peltola +2; Aug open primary Peltola 49.5%, Sullivan 41.4%). En route to Alaska, Trump endorsed Republican businesswoman Bernadette Wilson for governor on Truth Social, publicly calling out fellow Republicans Dave Bronson (accused of reneging on a promise to drop out - Bronson denies it) and Treg Taylor (dismissed as someone he'd 'never heard of') and urging GOP consolidation behind Wilson; he also attacked ranked-choice voting as a 'bogus rigged deal.' AK voters also decide an open-primary/ranked-choice repeal Nov 3 (a 2024 repeal failed by 743 votes); AK early voting starts Oct 19. Confirmed across three independent Alaska outlets with original bylines (Juneau Independent/Alaska Beacon, Alaska News, KTVF live blog).

items.event_time_ist: Remarks ~6:30 AM IST, Oct 14 (5:30 PM PDT, Oct 13); Reuters report published ~6:40 AM IST, Oct 14 (5:10 PM PDT, Oct 13)
items.title: At Wasilla rally, Trump warns Iran 'we're going to hit them hard'; Reuters reports Tehran escalated Hormuz attacks to pressure midterms
items.summary: Trump told the Wasilla crowd 'wait and see what we do to Iran. We're going to hit them hard... because we've had enough' - an escalation from his line days earlier that there would be no strike before the midterms amid 'productive' talks. Separately, Reuters reported (two senior Iranian officials) that Tehran adopted new shipping-attack tactics in the Strait of Hormuz about 10 days ago with the explicit goal of keeping oil prices high and influencing the US vote, a decision taken 'at the highest levels.' Rally quote carried by multiple aggregators (JBizNews, NewsBeep, JFeed, Daily Inference); Reuters independently confirms the Hormuz-midterms pressure story. Single-sourced on the exact rally quote.
items.source_name: NewsBeep (carrying rally remarks; Reuters cited within)
